summary: Verify run 36971653610 failed with OIDC subject not allowed because live CI auth still trusted the name-only subject repo:<owner>/<repository>:*. Bootstrap could not apply the immutable subject: the auth resource was renamed from ci to github without preserving its state address, retired CI resources were scheduled for deletion, and <repository>:main was imported despite no protection rule existing. Keep the auth address, forget retired resources without destruction, and create the missing rule instead of importing it.
